q: What proof of renewable electricity will a buyer accept from my factory?
title: Proof of renewable electricity
short: Documents that show you own the renewable attribute for the units you claim: green tariff bills from the discom, retired renewable energy certificates, open access invoices with the certificates, or generation meter readings from your own rooftop solar.
audience: Exporters asked to show renewable electricity use

ul: Green tariff bills naming the units and period.
REC or I-REC retirement statements in your name.
Open access or group captive contracts with generation and allocation statements.

p: Certificates sold on or claimed twice, and solar units already exported to the grid. The GHG Protocol's quality criteria apply to every claim.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills, including kVAh, demand and solar export lines, into dated records with the units, factor and year behind every Scope 2 figure.
